clips.title: The story
paras: Feather Charms are crude magical trinkets carried by Frostmane troll novices in the snow-swept valleys of Coldridge Valley. Though fashioned from simple materials, they harbor an innate sorcerous resonance that catches the eye of local warlock mentors.

The Frostmane trolls inhabiting the snowy caverns southwest of Anvilmar are known mostly for territorial savagery, but their novices dabble in primitive spellcraft. The feather charms carried by these young trolls hold a faint yet unmistakable magical power. In Anvilmar, warlock instructor Alamar Grimm considers them an intriguing subject of study—surprising for crude trollcraft—and uses them as a proving ground for fledgling warlocks seeking to master the binding of their first imp.
